_about: Store texts of the new product, checked by listing.py before they are submitted: limits, empty fields, and the original's names from teardown/brand.json. Write them fresh from the angle in teardown/fixes.md, in the store's language; never the original's wording or name. Remove the store you do not publish to. For several store languages, put one block per language under "locales", e.g. {"locales": {"de-DE": {"app_store": {...}}, "en-US": {...}}}.
